label: Notch 45° (Semi-notch)
description: The 45-degree semi-notch lapel sits at an unusually low, almost horizontal angle where the collar meets the lapel, producing a relaxed, casual character that softens the formality of any jacket. This very shallow cut draws the eye inward toward the chest with a gentle, unhurried line, giving single-breasted suits a relaxed, Continental ease. It is associated with soft-constructed Neapolitan tailoring and works best on unstructured or lightly structured jackets intended for day or leisure wear.
